title: Response Board tabs, project routing, and persistent staging tray
outcome: Extend the existing singleton Response Board into one global durable card collection partitioned by lightweight tabs. Each workspace pane remembers its active Response Board tab and per-tab camera state. Pinning creates an immutable staged card in the selected tab; staged cards can be previewed, placed on the spatial canvas, returned to staging, moved between tabs, or deleted. Add project-default tabs and optional routing by the source session project while preserving custom cross-project tabs and the existing legacy API behavior.
acceptance: Existing cards migrate verbatim into the default Response Board tab as placed cards; tabs can be created, selected, renamed, ordered, and safely deleted; each pane independently persists active tab and per-tab view state; staged cards persist across restart and are displayed as an accessible compact tray; drag or keyboard placement transitions staged cards to placed without copying their immutable snapshot; placed cards can return to staging or move tabs; pin is idempotent per tab and routes to last-active tab in V1 and optionally to a project-default tab in V2; the legacy /api/response-board contract remains compatible and returns default-tab placed cards; mobile/bot compatibility and full migration/API/UI regressions pass.
